name: Conditional necessity, overlap and residual function
description: Represent whether a target is needed for a named outcome under specified conditions and available alternatives: absolute loss, quantitative impairment, hidden overlap or no detected phenotype.
claim_scope: Necessity attaches to function, assay and background, not a context-free essential-gene label. It can remain unresolved after deletion failure or overexpression rescue.
distinctions: Single-gene dispensability versus required combined function.
Residual output versus complete tested loss.
Failed deletion recovery versus demonstrated essentiality.
No phenotype versus no native contribution.

example_structured_values.meaning: Finite examples of declared values/reference types, not a complete ontology, numerical credit scale, adopted scoring axis or claim of existing runtime compatibility.

not_established: No recovered deletion is not essentiality proof.
Residual growth does not identify a backup enzyme.
Overlap in one condition does not prove complete equivalence.
boundary: A09 records dependence given alternatives. A10 identifies what the alternative supplies. Neither rescue nor necessity alone assigns exact chemistry.

evidence.source_locator: DUF208 Is Needed; Fig. 3; complementation Fig. 4; purification limits.
evidence.observation: Single queG/duf208 deletions retain Q; double loss accumulates oQ and removes Q, exposing overlapping cellular requirements.
evidence.limit: Not isolated productive QueH catalysis or established native metal/donor identity.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Full genomic, growth, complementation, transcriptomic and cysteine-mutant results, discussion, and phylogenetic methods read. Author data/code not rerun; no purified-enzyme activity claimed.
evidence.observation: Sulfide-containing medium masks an absolute CoM-growth requirement; removal and complementation reveal conditional dependence.
evidence.limit: Possible L-ASST backup remains unproven; author data/code not rerun.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: 2012 Results/Methods; 2016 MeDH Results/growth/glassware/assay methods and ExaF Results, tables and assay details. Published curves/tables inspected; no numerical raw OD data reanalysis.
evidence.observation: Residual growth after removing known oxidation routes exposes ExaF and constrains exclusive XoxF/single-paralog necessity.
evidence.limit: No raw growth-curve reanalysis; metal condition and strain scope remain necessary.

evidence.observation: Positive esterase chemistry and rescue coexist with failed native deletion recovery, which does not prove essentiality or defective uptake.
evidence.limit: Failed native deletion is an experimental limitation, not an adopted uptake mechanism.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Full Results examined, including specificity controls and rescue. Same protein-family investigation group as cellular_ybeY; not independent replication of all E. coli claims.
evidence.observation: Removing rnr permits yqfG loss while specific 16S maturation defects bound the contribution.
evidence.limit: Does not transfer all E. coli YbeY phenotypes or resolve every ribosome-turnover mechanism.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Full 2017 methods/results page inspected, including genetic, sequence and structural sections. 2014 primary abstract inspected. No new sequence calculation or wet-lab work.
evidence.observation: HisN loss leaves residual growth; cg0911 overexpression rescues, but native cg0911 deletion does not explain that residual function.
evidence.limit: Backup remains unassigned; overexpression capacity does not establish routine native role.
